Morbid Metal - Early Access Accolades Trailer
The critics have spoken — and Morbid Metal is already live in Early Access. Jump in, shapeshift, and carve your own path.

Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

Morbid Metal is a roguelite hack'n slash game in which you battle fearsome enemies in a dark sci-fi universe. Instantly switch characters to take advantage of their unique characteristics and perform devastating combos. Every victory makes you stronger, every defeat is an opportunity to progress.

Developed by Screenjuice in Unity and published by Ubisoft.
🔻 Follow the game for updates and exclusive content! 🔻

About For Honor:
Step into the battlefield to experience the chaos and glory found only in For Honor. 

Whether battling through a gripping campaign or clashing with others in intense multiplayer modes and PvP modes, players choose from history’s deadliest warriors, each from a fierce rival faction — the bold Knights, the brutal Vikings, the deadly Samurai, the fearsome Wu Lin, and the enigmatic Outlanders. 

For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience that continues to evolve with major gameplay updates, new Heroes, thrilling events, and more, keeping the conflict alive and ever challenging.
